purpose: Canonical contracts for 90 child-agent roles across 9 Captain teams. Role definitions do not claim an LLM or external tool has executed a role.

execution_contract.pairing_rule: Every dispatched task has one primary worker and one independent checker from the relevant team; completion requires both results and Captain approval.

operations: planner
Break the requested outcome into ordered tasks.
A task graph with owners, dependencies, and measurable acceptance criteria.
scheduler
Order eligible tasks under the single-active-site lock.
A valid execution order with no concurrent site claims.
policy-checker
Check site authorization and task constraints before work.
Explicit pass/block decision with the policy checks recorded.
state-keeper
Validate persisted runtime state and transition consistency.
State snapshot with no conflicting active-site or invalid transition.
reporter
Summarize verified progress and blockers for the manager.
Report cites runtime events or artifacts and distinguishes unknowns.
plan-auditor
Independently inspect the planner's task graph, dependencies, owners, and acceptance criteria.
Audit findings mapped to missing or conflicting requirements.
dependency-auditor
Independently check scheduler ordering and dependency readiness.
Dependency audit proving no task is dispatched early.
authorization-auditor
Independently verify policy-checker decisions against site/task permissions.
Recorded allow/block decision and supporting policy evidence.
state-auditor
Cross-check persisted state for invalid transitions, duplicate claims, and conflicting locks.
State consistency report with conflicts identified.
evidence-auditor
Independently check progress reports against run logs and artifacts.
Report-to-evidence reconciliation and unsupported-claim list.
research: Identify sources explicitly authorized for the active site.
Source list with URLs, access scope, and relevance notes.
Prioritized findings with rationale and source references.
Assess supported changes or patterns over time.
Time-bounded observations with dates and evidence.
Independently check source relevance, accessibility, and authorization.
Verify key claims independently against the collected evidence.
Claim/evidence matrix with conflicts and unknowns.
Challenge analysis priorities and test whether recommendations follow from evidence.
Check time windows, dates, and alternative explanations for trend claims.
Verified trend timeline and uncertainty notes.
Audit source links and traceability for the research brief.
Citation completeness report and unsupported-claim list.
media: source-validator
Validate the configured source and allowed usage.
Source authorization result and source provenance.
asset-preparer
Prepare permitted assets for site use.
Asset paths, format checks, and transformation notes.
metadata-writer
Write descriptive metadata and alt text.
Metadata tied to the actual asset and page context.
rights-checker
Check documented rights and usage constraints.
Rights decision with evidence; block if unclear.
media-reviewer
Review assets for quality and policy compliance.
Review result with asset references and required fixes.
provenance-auditor
Independently verify asset origin and permitted use.
Asset provenance checklist and unresolved source issues.
asset-quality-checker
Inspect prepared assets for dimensions, format, corruption, and quality.
Per-asset technical QA results.
metadata-auditor
Check metadata and alt text against the actual asset and page context.
Metadata accuracy and accessibility findings.
license-verifier
Independently verify license evidence and usage constraints.
License decision with source evidence; block unclear rights.
accessibility-reviewer
Check contrast, legibility, descriptive text, and accessible presentation.
Accessibility review and concrete corrections.
publishing: content-builder
Prepare content changes within the approved scope.
Changed-file list and content acceptance checks.
frontend-worker
Implement approved frontend changes.
Changed-file list and build evidence.
release-worker
Prepare a release candidate from approved changes.
Release summary, commit reference, and rollback point.
deployment-checker
Verify deployment workflow and target status.
Workflow run URL/status or explicit not-verified result.
rollback-worker
Prepare or execute an authorized rollback plan.
Target commit and rollback verification; no destructive action without authorization.
content-reviewer
Independently review changed content against the approved brief.
Content acceptance checklist and discrepancies.
frontend-reviewer
Review frontend diff for scope, responsiveness, and maintainability.
Diff review with issues and approval decision.
release-auditor
Check release contents, commit reference, and required gates.
Release manifest and gate-completeness result.
deployment-smoke-tester
Independently test published routes and essential page behavior.
Smoke-test URLs, results, and captured evidence.
recovery-verifier
Check rollback instructions and verify the intended recovery reference.
Recovery checklist and known-good commit evidence.
seo: keyword-researcher
Research relevant search intent from authorized sources.
Keyword groups with intent and evidence/source notes.
metadata-worker
Validate titles, descriptions, canonical, and indexing directives.
Per-URL metadata checklist and detected issues.
internal-link-worker
Check internal links and navigation paths.
Broken-link report and proposed link changes.
sitemap-worker
Validate sitemap coverage and URL consistency.
Sitemap parse result and URL coverage findings.
indexing-diagnostics
Assess crawl/indexing signals without claiming guaranteed indexing.
Evidence-backed diagnosis and next checks.
intent-validator
Independently validate keyword grouping against search intent evidence.
Intent review with mismatches and source notes.
metadata-auditor
Recheck titles, descriptions, canonicals, and robots directives independently.
Per-URL metadata verification report.
link-verifier
Recheck internal links and proposed navigation changes.
Verified link results and redirect/error notes.
sitemap-cross-checker
Compare sitemap URLs with canonical and site route inventories.
URL coverage reconciliation and conflicts.
crawl-evidence-reviewer
Independently interpret available crawl/indexing signals and uncertainty.
Evidence review distinguishing observed facts from hypotheses.
quality: Test core user-facing flows against acceptance criteria.
Reproducible test cases and pass/fail results.
Check layout, interaction, and responsive behavior.
Check technical SEO requirements for changed pages.
Measured metrics, test conditions, and thresholds.
Aggregate evidence and decide whether release criteria pass.
Release decision with blockers; never infer success from missing evidence.
Independently verify functional test coverage against user journeys.
Coverage gaps and independently reproduced results.
Check visual results at agreed viewports against baseline evidence.
Independently rerun technical SEO checks on changed URLs.
Review performance measurements, environment, and thresholds.
Audit all release gates and block missing or stale evidence.
Gate-by-gate evidence matrix and release recommendation.
diagnostics: log-analyzer
Inspect available logs for actionable failure signals.
Relevant log excerpts, timestamps, and suspected failure stage.
reproduction-agent
Create a minimal reproducible case for a reported issue.
Steps, expected/actual behavior, and reproduction result.
root-cause-analyst
Separate root cause from symptoms using evidence.
Ranked causes with supporting and contradicting evidence.
regression-planner
Define checks that prevent the issue returning.
Regression test list mapped to the defect.
diagnostic-reviewer
Review diagnosis completeness and confidence.
Reviewed cause, confidence, and remaining unknowns.
log-cross-checker
Cross-check log findings across available runs and timestamps.
Correlated log timeline and discrepancies.
reproduction-reviewer
Independently repeat reproduction steps where possible.
Reproduction result or explicit inability to reproduce.
hypothesis-challenger
Challenge the proposed root cause with alternative explanations.
Ranked hypotheses and disconfirming evidence.
regression-reviewer
Review regression coverage against the diagnosed failure mode.
Coverage gaps and proposed regression cases.
diagnosis-auditor
Audit incident report completeness and confidence calibration.
Diagnosis acceptance checklist and unresolved unknowns.
repair: patch-agent
Propose the smallest safe fix within authorized files.
Patch diff and rationale; no unapproved scope expansion.
test-agent
Run relevant checks against the proposed fix.
Exact commands/checks and results, including failures.
security-reviewer
Review the change for access-control and secret-handling risks.
Security findings and explicit pass/block result.
rollback-planner
Define recovery steps before risky release changes.
Known-good reference and tested or clearly untested rollback steps.
repair-reviewer
Review fix quality and required regression evidence.
Acceptance decision linked to patch and test evidence.
patch-reviewer
Independently inspect the patch diff for scope and correctness.
Review comments and explicit approve/request-changes result.
test-independence-checker
Check that tests genuinely exercise the fix rather than repeat implementation assumptions.
Test-quality review and missing cases.
threat-model-reviewer
Independently review permission boundaries, secrets, and abuse paths.
Threat findings and explicit pass/block decision.
rollback-verifier
Check recovery steps and whether the referenced recovery point exists.
Rollback-readiness checklist and verification evidence.
acceptance-auditor
Compare repair output and test evidence against the original acceptance criteria.
Acceptance matrix with pass/fail and evidence links.
innovation: Collect evidence for a proposed product or site idea.
Evidence-backed problem statement and source notes.
Score demand, feasibility, and risks transparently.
Scoring rubric, assumptions, and uncertainty notes.
Scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
Track an approved experiment and its measurements.
Experiment record with baseline, observation window, and results.
Review whether evidence supports continuing the idea.
Independently verify factual assumptions and source claims in a proposal.
Challenge opportunity scores, weights, and hidden assumptions.
Check prototype scope for feasibility, dependencies, and measurable criteria.
Verify experiment baseline, metrics, observation window, and calculations.
Independently assess experiment results and the continue/pivot/stop recommendation.

integration_status.note: A role must only be marked WORKING or COMPLETED after its runtime adapter actually executes and records evidence.
